hook: A declassified MISREP from the 77th Expeditionary Fighter Squadron documents a 2-ship F-16CM crew's observation of 10-20 bright, fast-moving objects during a Defensive Counter Air mission over the ESSA killbox during Operation Inherent Resolve, with one object tracked on a SNIPER targeting pod for approximately 20 seconds before dimming and vanishing.
why_it_matters: This report is significant because it documents sensor-corroborated UAP observations by trained military aviators in an active combat theater, with the crew explicitly comparing the targeting pod return of the UAP against a known star and noting the results were 'DIFFERENT.' The implied altitude of FL600+ for the objects — over 60,000 feet — placed them well above the F-16's operating altitude of FL265, ruling out common airspace traffic. The report also notes that unlike 'prior sorties,' no formations were observed, suggesting a recurring phenomenon documented across multiple missions.

key_findings.finding: The crew observed a possible 10 to 20 bright objects maneuvering quickly from west to east, at an estimated altitude above FL600 (above 60,000 feet), while the aircraft operated at FL265.

quotes.text: STARTING AT 2302:052 ~FLT OBSERVED SEVERAL BRIGHT OBJECTS MANUEVERING QUICKLY WEST TO EAST NE OF RLZ
UAP Altitude, Depth, Velocity, and Trajectory (indicate estimated or measured): FL600+

key_findings.finding: One of the objects was tracked on the SNIPER targeting pod in TV (electro-optical) mode for approximately 20 seconds before it dimmed and disappeared from the sensor.

quotes.text: FLT WOULD OBTAIN POSS UAP ON TARGETING POD (TV MODE) FOR APPROX 20S BEFORE OBJECT WOULD BECOME DIM AND DISAPPEAR FROM TARGETING POD.

key_findings.finding: An analyst note — partially redacted — records that the crew compared the targeting pod return of the UAP against a star, and the results were different, indicating the object did not behave like a celestial body on sensor.

quotes.text: ANALYST COMMENT:! 1.4a IFLT COMPARED TARGETING POD BETWEEN POSS UAP AND STAR. RESULTS WERE DIFFERENT.

key_findings.finding: The report explicitly notes the objects were not in formations, contrasting with observations from prior sorties — implying a documented history of UAP sightings in this operational area, some of which featured formations.

quotes.text: NONE OF THE OBJECTS WERE SEEN IN ANY FORMATIONS AS PREVIOUSLY SEEN IN PRIOR SORTIES. NFTR.

key_findings.finding: The mission was a 6-hour 47-minute Defensive Counter Air sortie flown by two F-16CMs from Prince Sultan Air Base under Operation Inherent Resolve, with the UAP contact occurring at 2302Z while the aircraft was on station in the ESSA killbox.

quotes.text: FLT WAS FRAGGED TO CONDUCT DCA IN THE ESSA (2100-0000). MISSION WAS FLOWN AS FRAGGED.

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: The document was explicitly declassified and released to AARO, and the MISREP format and UAP section conform to AARO's standardized military reporting pipeline for UAP incidents.
The Operation Inherent Resolve theater (Iraq/Syria) involves multi-agency intelligence activity, though the document itself is an Air Force tactical report with no direct OGA reference.
